paper.title: Replication package for: Severity is not exploitation: An explainable machine learning analysis of CVSS scores and known exploited vulnerabilities
paper.venue: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
paper.abstract: Code and data to reproduce all results in the article “Severity is not exploitation: An explainable machine learning analysis of CVSS scores and known exploited vulnerabilities”. The package uses public secondary data only: National Vulnerability Database records (CVEs published 2018–2023, via the fkie-cad/nvd-json-data-feeds mirror, commit f5aef06, 14 Oct 2026) and the CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog (v2026.10.13). It includes Python code (run_all.py), pinned requirements, derived datasets, model outputs and figures. The package is split into two archives (partA: code, outputs, KEV and derived data; partB: parsed NVD data); extract both into the same folder before running. This product uses data from the NVD API but is not endorsed or certified by the NVD.
